intent: Turn recurring failures in reviewed development traces into bounded skill-edit proposals while keeping held-out evidence sealed until evaluation.
successCondition: A deterministic staged proposal cites recurring development-only evidence, remains inactive by default, and can advance only after a leakage-free held-out gain with no critical regression or unresolved effect.
operations: validate and mine development-only failure evidence
stage a bounded proposal without editing a live skill
compare held-out baseline and candidate evidence
fail closed on leakage regression unresolved effects or absent gain
positiveTriggers: improve a reusable skill from recurring reviewed failures
evaluate a staged skill revision against held-out cases
negativeTriggers: silently rewrite a live skill from raw transcripts
use held-out answers while constructing the proposal
failureModes: trace evidence is unreviewed malformed or not development-partitioned
failure recurrence is below the declared threshold
proposal construction overlaps held-out identities or digests
candidate evidence regresses a critical case or lacks measured gain
proposal exceeds its edit budget or targets a different baseline digest
